newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air cargo exports rise 11pct in October.
newsitem.headline: German air cargo exports rise 11pct in October.

text.p: German exports flown as air cargo to international destinations rose 11 percent to 96,038 tonnes in October, figures from the German airports authority ADV showed.
This followed 7.9 percent growth in September and leaves January-October flown air cargo volumes up year-on-year by 5.8 percent at 826,719 tonnes, the latest ADV monthly traffic report said.
Air cargo imports at the 16 international German airports rose 8.7 percent in October to 84,342 tonnes, it added.
Imports have grown five percent to 753,724 tonnes over the first ten months of 1996, the report said.
Air mail fell 4.7 percent to 29,463 tonnes in October and has decreased 3.3 percent to 290,809 tonnes over the first ten months. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
